clean_apply.method: the generated patch reverse-applies cleanly to the current overlay on the pinned base, proving the overlay bytes are exactly the patch result

completion_target.name: production-ready for the defined Cortex-M firmware corpus
completion_target.policy: every observed corpus feature must either be rewritten through the checked pipeline or retained unchanged with an explicit diagnostic
completion_target.supersedes: open-ended parity with every x86 BOLT backend capability

mechanism.abi_contract: R_ARM_TLS_GD32 computes TLSGD(S)+A-P, where TLSGD(S) is the address of the retained two-word {module index, DTP offset} descriptor rather than the STT_TLS symbol address

ambiguous_duplicate_descriptor.diagnostic: R_ARM_TLS_GD32 target tls_data has multiple exact retained TLS GD descriptors

scope_limits: the milestone qualifies static local-executable TLS general-dynamic descriptors in one exact retained file-backed GOT graph; dynamic-loader TLS, weak or undefined TLS symbols and other TLS models remain governed by separate contracts
the fixture proves linked relocation arithmetic, exact origin mapping and architectural execution under the admitted static runtime; it is not a general-purpose thread runtime or device model
production readiness is evaluated against the frozen defined Cortex-M corpus, not by claiming parity with every x86 BOLT feature or every ARM ecosystem binary
patch-aware transformation semantics remain a later phase; this production gate uses the explicit empty patch contract

source_changes.bolt: the ARM relocation handler imports, classifies, extracts and emits TLS_GD32 under the fixed-static policy; analysis resolves one exact retained TLS descriptor and keeps it distinct from ordinary pointer GOT slots
source_changes.jitlink: AArch32 carries a distinct TLS-GD descriptor request edge that FirmBOLT binds to the recorded absolute descriptor before applying a Data_Delta32 fixup
source_changes.llvm_mc: the ARM ELF writer now preserves S_TLSGD for an explicitly PC-relative four-byte data expression emitted by BOLT
source_changes.tests: the moved-literal positive fixture, architectural execution and missing-policy/duplicate-descriptor controls make target-address guessing and retained-byte no-ops fail observably
